title: Persuasive or Deceptive Visualization?
description: A team project for DSC 106 that argues both sides of "China, not the United States, is most responsible for climate change" using the same CO2 data. One chart uses annual emissions since 1990 and the other uses cumulative emissions since 1960, to show how design choices like the time window change which country looks more responsible.

title: GG or FF? Predicting Pro League of Legends Outcomes
description: A DSC 80 project with Jeffrey Kang that predicts wins and losses in 2025 pro League of Legends games. It covers data cleaning, missingness analysis, hypothesis testing for a blue side advantage, and a tuned random forest model that reached about 83% test accuracy, plus a fairness check on support players.

title: Personal portfolio website
description: A responsive portfolio built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It has a JS-generated navigation bar, a dark mode switch that remembers your choice, and project cards loaded from a JSON file.

title: UTime
description: A Swift iOS app built to encourage better study habits and productivity, with a focus on reducing procrastination when you're under stress. Developed as part of Kode With Klossy (KWK) 2025.

title: Campus Dining Wait Time Tracker
description: Students waste time standing in long lines at dining halls. This project collects crowd reports and estimates wait times so people can pick the quietest spot.

title: Spotify Listening Habits Analysis
description: An exploration of how listening patterns change across the school year. It looks for links between study seasons, time of day, and the genres people pick.

title: Housing Price Predictor
description: Renters and buyers struggle to tell whether a listing is fairly priced. This regression model estimates prices from size, location, and age, and flags listings that look off.

title: Recycling Sorter
description: People often put items in the wrong bin. This image classifier suggests whether an item is recyclable, compostable, or trash from a single photo.

title: Study Group Matcher
description: Finding classmates who share your schedule and courses is harder than it should be. This web app pairs students based on availability and the classes they are taking.

title: Library Seat Finder
description: Library seats fill up fast during finals week. This tool shows which floors have open seating so students do not have to walk around searching.

title: Weather Dashboard
description: Weather apps bury the details people actually care about. This dashboard pulls forecast data and charts temperature, wind, and rain on one clean page.

title: Budget Buddy
description: Many students lose track of where their money goes each month. This small app logs expenses by category and shows simple charts of spending over time.
